description: UPGMA dendrogram (scipy) of carriers to visualize Dic4 clade placement
code:
import requests, numpy as np
from itertools import combinations
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, dendrogram
from scipy.spatial.distance import squareform
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def fasta(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=30)
    return "".join(r.text.splitlines()[1:])

accs={
 "Dic4_Q9VVS1":"Q9VVS1","Dic1_CG8790":"Q9Y166","Dic2_CG4323":"Q9VDM3","Dic3_CG11196":"A1Z787",
 "Tpc1_CG6608":"Q0KI86","Tpc2_CG2857":"Q9W0Y9",
 "hTPC_SLC25A19":"Q9HC21","hDIC_SLC25A10":"Q9UBX3","hOGC_SLC25A11":"Q02978",
}
S={k:fasta(v) for k,v in accs.items()}

def nw_identity(a,b,gap=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); H[:,0]=-np.arange(n+1); H[0,:]=-np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]; prev=H[i-1]; row=H[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            sc=1 if ai==b[j-1] else -1
            row[j]=max(prev[j-1]+sc, prev[j]+gap, row[j-1]+gap)
    i,j=n,m; match=alnlen=0
    while i>0 and j>0:
        sc=1 if a[i-1]==b[j-1] else -1
        if H[i,j]==H[i-1,j-1]+sc: alnlen+=1; match+=(a[i-1]==b[j-1]); i-=1;j-=1
        elif H[i,j]==H[i-1,j]+gap: i-=1; alnlen+=1
        else: j-=1; alnlen+=1
    return 100*match/alnlen

names=list(accs); N=len(names)
D=np.zeros((N,N))
for a,b in combinations(range(N),2):
    d=1-nw_identity(S[names[a]],S[names[b]])/100
    D[a,b]=D[b,a]=d

Z=linkage(squareform(D,checks=False), method="average")
plt.figure(figsize=(8,4))
dendrogram(Z, labels=names, orientation="right", leaf_font_size=9)
plt.title("UPGMA of Drosophila Dic/Tpc + human SLC25 carriers (1 - global %id)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("carrier_tree.png",dpi=120)
print("saved carrier_tree.png")

# print merge order to read clades
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import fcluster
for k in [2,3,4]:
    cl=fcluster(Z,k,criterion="maxclust")
    print(f"k={k}:", {names[i]:int(cl[i]) for i in range(N)})
